stage1.impression: A tidy, symmetrical CG showroom render: two clear-acrylic speakers on oak blocks in a warm fir-lined niche, with a blank brown floor and the black silhouettes of two chairs in the foreground. The fir slats repeat one streaky texture, the floor and left wall have no material, the white batts behind the left speaker's acrylic are blown, and no glass, record or lamp suggests anyone uses the room. A magazine would see a generic hi-fi demo room, not a specific place, and would not run it.

blocking_9: The listening zone needs to be in the picture: at least one tub chair, an oak table with a glowing Orb lamp and a prop (a glass, a record out of its sleeve, the coat) in a lit pool in the foreground, readable (foreground median 22 or more, not black silhouettes).

The shell needs to read as board-formed concrete, Douglas fir beams and blackened steel somewhere in the frame. At present the left wall and floor are featureless dark planes (left wall median 17.5, floor lum_range 32).
The fir lining needs board-to-board variation in tone and grain, with checks and nail holes, and no visible repeat of a single texture.
No blown white areas on the speakers: the left speaker's top batt band reads p95 247 with median 243.
The speakers need to read as smoked, tinted cast acrylic, which is the configuration. At present they read as clear boxes with grey and white internals (see out_of_scope).
The floor needs a believable material with a soft sheen that catches the plinths and spots, not a matte brown plane.
The light needs to come from visible practicals (Orbs, candles) in addition to the hidden altar spots, so the frame shows pools of light with dark between them.

defects.what: White batt band behind the left speaker's acrylic is blown flat white (median 242.9) and reads as a paper insert.
The left speaker is about 45 % brighter than the right (median 67.1 vs 46.5), so the pair is lit unevenly.
The fir slats are one repeated streaky texture with identical tone and evenly spaced dark grooves. It reads as CG cladding, with no checks, knots or end grain.
The floor is a featureless matte brown plane (median 26, lum_range 32), with no texture, sheen or reflection of the plinths.
The left shell wall is flat dark plaster with no concrete tie holes or board marks (median 17.5).
The screen on the left wall has a soft hotspot blob and reads as a grey panel, with no image legible.
The foreground tub chairs are near-black silhouettes (median 12) with no velvet texture, and no Orb, table or prop is visible.
A table edge at the left frame edge is cut off and unlit.
A flat beige sleeve or board leans against the right plinth and reads as untextured cardboard. The right speaker also sits off-centre to the left on its plinth.
The horn mouths show a large black-and-white smeared reflection that reads as an environment map, not the room.
The dark panels behind the speakers are flat black rectangles that read as switched-off TVs.
The niche soffit has two clipped downlight hotspots (p95 237) with no fixtures visible.
No sign of life or atmosphere. The haze is invisible, and the frame reads as an empty showroom.

changes.problem: The frame shows the altar from an empty, dark middle distance and leaves out the zone the card says the frame is for: the tub chairs, the oak tables, the Core lamps and the props.

evidence.measured: The foreground chairs are silhouettes at median 12, and no Orb, table or prop is visible anywhere in the frame.

change.to: seated eye level about 1.05 m, about 1.2 m further back and 0.4 m toward y 2.5, so that one tub chair's arm, an oak table with its Orb, a coupe and a record sleeve fill the lower-right third in focus range. Use a 35 mm lens at f/4, focused on the nearer speaker, with true verticals.

changes.expected: The zone reads as a place people sit in. The altar stays the hero in the upper-middle, framed by furniture and lamp glow instead of an empty floor.

changes.problem: The Orb table lamps are far too dim to show, so the zone has no pools of light and the foreground falls to black.

evidence.measured: lum_median 12.0, p95 37.7, crush in the bottom-right corner.

changes.expected: Each table carries a warm pool about 0.6 m across, and the velvet chairs, glasses and sleeves pick up highlights. The foreground median rises into the 22 to 35 range without clipping the liners.

changes.problem: The altar spots blow out the white batts in the left speaker and light the pair unevenly.

evidence.measured: median 242.9, p95 247.3. Left speaker median 67.1 vs right 46.5.

change.to: 38 W each, cone 24 deg, re-aimed at each speaker's horn and cabinet centre with matched distance. Add a soft 20 % blend edge so the batts sit about one stop under white.

changes.expected: Both speakers read alike. The batts show texture through the acrylic, and the cabinets' edges catch the light.

changes.problem: The Douglas fir lining is one tiled texture with uniform board tone and CG-straight grain.

evidence.measured: lum_range 88 across eight boards, mostly lighting falloff. At 3x crop every board is the same streak pattern.

change.to: per-board random UV offset and rotation, ±12 % tone and ±5 % hue variation per board, a few checks and nail holes, slightly darker grooves with a 2 mm shadow gap, matte oil sheen (roughness about 0.55)

changes.expected: The boards read as individual old-growth fir at 1:1, with no visible repeat.

changes.problem: The floor is a blank matte plane with no material, sheen or reflection.

evidence.measured: lum_median 33.7, p95 77.4. Profile down the floor falls smoothly from 40.5 to 13.8 with no texture.

change.to: honed concrete or oiled timber with roughness about 0.3, a low-contrast mottle and saw-cut joints, so the plinths, the altar spots and the Orbs leave soft reflections

changes.expected: Soft reflected streaks under each plinth and a readable floor material near the step.

changes.problem: The shell around the niche (concrete, steel) is unlit and reads as flat dark plaster, so the room is not specific.

evidence.measured: lum_median 17.5, p95 48.2, no surface detail at 2x.

change.setting: the record-wall spots, or the Domes' downlights in view
change.from: 6.0 W / 32 W as now, missing this wall
change.to: one 2600 K wall-grazer at about 10 W, aimed down the left concrete wall from 0.3 m off it. Raise the concrete's micro-roughness and bump so the tie holes and board marks rake.

changes.expected: A grazed gradient on the board-formed concrete, bright at the top and falling to dark, with the formwork lines readable.

changes.problem: There is no sign of life: the props the card lists (a record out of its sleeve, a coat over a tub chair, glasses) are not visible, and the lean-to sleeve at the right plinth reads as flat cardboard.

evidence.measured: A flat beige rectangle with no print (median 49.5). No glass or record found in the frame.

change.from: round 39 props: 1 rocks, 1 votives, the sleeve against the plinth
change.to: a coupe and a rocks glass on the nearest table in the Orb's pool, a record on the platter-side table with its printed sleeve beside it, the coat over the nearest tub chair's arm, and the leaning sleeve given real dark printed artwork and worn edges

changes.expected: Two or three small specular highlights and one printed sleeve in the foreground, which make the room read as in use.

changes.problem: The air has no atmosphere and the soffit's downlight hotspots clip.

evidence.measured: p95 237.1, clip 0.05 %, haze not visible in the altar beams.

change.to: 0.014 per metre, exposure 4.7, with a gentle highlight roll-off in the grade

changes.expected: Faint cones from the altar spots and the soffit hotspots under clipping, while the frame median stays in band.

out_of_scope.request: Make the speaker cabinets read clearly as smoked, tinted acrylic, and make the horns show the room instead of a smeared black-and-white reflection.
out_of_scope.why: The speakers' colour, parts and material are fixed by the card. If the Smoke tint is not reaching the render, that is a model or asset issue for the owner to check, not a critic fix.

out_of_scope.request: Replace or rethink the flat black panels behind each speaker, which read as switched-off TVs.
out_of_scope.why: The niche and its panels are part of the room's fixed design.

out_of_scope.request: Centre the right speaker on its plinth.
out_of_scope.why: Placement on the altar is part of the fixed design. Check whether the offset is intended.
